hours.title: Support Hours
hours.desc: We are always here for you. Our technical support team is available 24/7. Feel free to contact us at any time, and we will be happy to assist you and ensure the quality of your subscription.

delivery.a: Delivery is instant! As soon as your payment is confirmed, you will be redirected to your dashboard where you can reveal your account credentials immediately.

legal.a: Yes, we resell legitimate shared access or discounted accounts. We do not sell stolen or hacked accounts.

warranty.a: Most accounts come with a warranty that matches the duration of the product (e.g., 1 Month, 1 Year). If an account stops working during this period, we will replace it for free.

password.a: No. These are shared or managed accounts. Changing the password, email, or profile settings may void your warranty instantly. Please use the credentials exactly as provided.

refund.a: We offer refunds only if the product is not delivered or if we cannot provide a working replacement for a defective account. Once credentials are viewed, standard refunds are not available.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We currently accept PayPal and major credit cards securely processed via PayPal.
